findings.key_quote: Fiscal Year 2026 Compared with Fiscal Year 2025 Revenue increased $50.1 billion or 18%
findings.justification: This passage directly states that revenue for fiscal year 2026 increased by 18% compared with fiscal year 2025. Since 18% is greater than 15%, this entails the assertion that revenue increased by more than 15%.

E7 shows FY2026 revenue of $331,839 million and E8 shows FY2025 revenue of $281,724 million. The growth rate is (331,839 - 281,724) / 281,724 = 17.79%, which is greater than 15%, entailing the assertion.
This derived metric shows the year-over-year revenue growth for fiscal year 2026 as approximately 17.79% (0.1779 as a ratio). This is greater than 15%, directly entailing the assertion.
This summary table shows revenue for 2026 of $331,839 million and 2025 of $281,724 million with an 18% increase. Since 18% exceeds 15%, this entails the assertion.
